goal: Avoid redundant local lookups and reduce latency on outbound I2P peer connections
Ensure unreachable I2P peers are recorded as connection failures rather than internal proxy errors
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile with no pending blockers or rebases needed
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Approach approval because router versions supporting direct connects are widely deployed (jonatack)
Resolved suggestion to add unit testing for direct stream connects and peer failure (jonatack)
